_comment: LLM-specific risk register for a Claude-based production system. likelihood/impact on a 1-5 scale. Educational sample values - re-score for your own workload.

risks.mitigation: RAG grounding + citations + groundedness output check + human review for high-stakes
input heuristic + classifier, untrusted-data envelope, operator role:system channel
quarantine + scan retrieved docs, treat tool output as data, least-privilege tools
input/output PII redaction, de-identification, ZDR/retention controls, egress filters
tool allowlist, argument validation, human approval gate on high-risk actions
confidence surfacing, AI disclosure, HITL sampling, decision explanations
structured outputs, eval harness, schema validation, snapshot tests of the control plane
token budgeting, compaction/context editing, put key facts at edges, retrieval over stuffing
RAG for fresh data, web_search for current events, display cutoff caveats
counterfactual tests, fairness metrics, attribute redaction, rubric decisions (see D5.5)
refusal-category routing, server-side fallback, prompt tuning, verification programs
step budgets, max_tokens caps, effort caps, per-session cost ceiling, circuit breaker
model-id abstraction, eval-gated upgrades, migration runbook, pin + monitor

risks.risk: Supply chain of tools / MCP servers
risks.mitigation: vet + pin MCP servers, least privilege, tool output as untrusted data, audit tool inventory
